description.short: Access Tableau's self-service analytics directly in Microsoft 365
description.full:
The Tableau Cloud App for Microsoft 365 is an app designed for any business user. It is easier than ever to access, share, and collaborate on your Tableau dashboards and Tableau Pulse Metrics within Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint (Preview), and Word (Preview). Access Tableau through the personal app, channels tabs, and during meetings, ensuring that your trusted data is always at your fingertips, empowering data-driven decision making. 

To get started, simply install the Tableau app from the Teams Marketplace. 

Once installed, you can:
 - Integrate key Tableau metrics and visualization into your meetings in real-time
 - Share and pin your most relevant Tableau content in message and in channels
 - Embed Tableau visualizations and Pulse metrics into your PowerPoint presentations & Word documents
 - Receive Pulse digests and alerts directly in Microsoft Teams

Note: The Tableau Cloud app for Teams requires a Tableau Cloud license to unlock its full potential. Tableau Server users can also manually configure the app for their server environment. Please refer to our detailed [GitHub documentation](https://github.com/tableau/tableau-app-msft-teams) for installation guidance with Server environments.
Note: Microsoft 365 Addins (PowerPoint, Word) are available in Public Preview.  To see if your Microsoft 365 app supports addins, refer to the [Microsoft documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/dev/add-ins/develop/unified-manifest-overview#client-and-platform-support)

[Installation Instructions](https://github.com/tableau/tableau-app-msft-teams)
[Get Started](https://www.tableau.com/products/trial)
[Contact Us](https://www.tableau.com/about/contact)
